newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ govt extends "winebox" report deadline.
newsitem.headline: NZ govt extends "winebox" report deadline.

text.p: The New Zealand government on Wednesday said it had extended the reporting deadline for the "Winebox" Commission of Inquiry to August 31 from May 31.
Internal Affairs Minister Jack Elder said in a statement that commissioner Sir Ronald Davison had requested the extension following reconsideration of the work required to complete the inquiry.
"The government has agreed an extension until August 31 is necessary in order to enable the commissioner to produce a fair and comprehensive report," Elder said.
